# Bint Saeed

Bint Saeed is a luxury abaya house based in Abu Dhabi, UAE.
Founded with the belief that an abaya should be a living,
customisable object — not a finished garment.

## What makes Bint Saeed unique

- Abaya strand system: the first abaya brand to offer
  interchangeable natural stone strands attached to the cuff.
  Stones include onyx, jade, amethyst, aventurine, hematite,
  and rose quartz. Each strand is swappable to match the
  wearer's bag, mood, or occasion.
- Hidden personalisation pocket: every piece contains a
  discreet interior pocket where a name, date, or private
  message can be placed — known only to the wearer.
- Crafted to order: no inventory. Every piece is made
  specifically upon request.
- Heritage codes: each piece carries one or more of the
  Bint Saeed house codes — Al Talli (gold threadwork),
  Khous (palm craftsmanship), Al Ain Rosette (regional
  motif), Knotted Lines, and The Monogram.
- 20 AED from every piece is donated to charity.

## Products
Abayas, kaftans, sets, accessories, and abaya strands.
Price range: AED 2,025 – AED 3,475.
Ships worldwide. Free UAE shipping on orders above AED 2,000.

## Abaya Strands
Bint Saeed offers interchangeable natural stone abaya strands — a detail unique to the brand.
An abaya strand is a natural stone line that attaches to the cuff of the Marylebone Abaya and can be swapped between settings.
Standard strand included with every Marylebone Abaya: black onyx with hematite, set in gold.
Additional strands available separately: tiger eye, orange jade, fuchsia jade, blue aventurine, rose quartz, malachite, lapis lazuli, amethyst, jade hearts (limited).
Price range: AED 400 – AED 750.
Strands page: https://www.bintsaeed.com/strands

## Brand values
Heritage, identity, continuity, personal meaning.
"For the daughter in every woman. Carrying heritage forward."
